push.title: W 4-2 vs pijany | You: 8.8 (2nd best match performance)
push.body:
An 8.8 against pijany, PhogsToffees. You made the hard things look ordinary, and that's a compliment.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at pijany's goal. You kept the keeper busier than a one-man band.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. You set the bar, now the rest of us get to chase it.
+ BellyTb1 owes you a milkshake for those passes.
+ Your 2nd best match performance (8.8). Keep stacking those.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Low-hanging fruit: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
- 70% passing (23 of 33). Quick fix: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- Funny how forcing passes snagged you and tuxedo_slide both. Remedy: give each other short options.
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 4. That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.

Kickabout task: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

Before you go, PhogsToffees: If plan A doesn't work, the alphabet has 25 more letters.

Celebrate, then sleep. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 50% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 0% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less)
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

push.title: W 4-2 vs pijany | You: 8.7 (2nd best match performance)
push.body:
Look at you, BellyTb1. An 8.7 against pijany. That's the good stuff.

THE GOOD
+ A hat trick against pijany, your 3rd straight match scoring. You finished it like the last bite of a good steak.
+ Your 2nd best match performance, at 8.7. Every season needs a few of these.
+ Tackles attempted 3, up from your usual 2. Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ Fewest misplaced passes on the team (8). That's growth you can count.
+ We beat pijany 4-2. Sweet as pecan pie.

THE BAD
- Won 0 of 3 tackles (down from your usual 39%). Between you and me: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 0 (best was PhogsToffees's 4). Small change, big gain: Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 50% (8 of 16). That's the part of tonight I'd burn if it were on paper. A little secret: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

This week's homework: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

Listen here, BellyTb1: Don't be afraid of the dark. That's when the stars come out.

Keep writing those happy chapters. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-2 vs pijany | You: 7.2 (worst match performance)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 7.2. I've seen you do better, which is exactly why I'm not worried.

THE GOOD
+ BellyTb1 scored and you were the reason. Take a bow.
+ Fewest missed tackles on the team (0). That right there is what good teammates do.
+ 1 key pass counted for +0.1. That's the hidden value in your game.
+ Passes attempted 21, from 11 in your previous match. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted. For next time: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized. That's a coach's honest word.
- 0 goals from 3 on target. Mind this: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide. Water the plant.
- That's your worst match performance with a 7.2. We go again.
- forcing passes hit you and PhogsToffees both. Partner drill: give each other short options.
- Worst assists of your 3 matches this session (0). That's not a crisis, but it's a warning light.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 48% (10 of 21). I've seen tidier yard sales. Easy win: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.

Skill builder: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

Remember, tuxedo_slide: Every game is a teacher. Some just grade harder.

Let's turn the page. - Coach Lasso
